# 3 Axial Skyrmions
- The reflection used alters the sign of only one pion field, leading to a relative phase difference of $\pi$ compared to definitions in references [3, 12, 7], where an antiSkyrmion is generated by negating all three pion fields.
- This paper's definition facilitates a more direct comparison with analogous situations involving monopoles.
- The profile function vanishes at a radius of s/2 from the center of the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion), enabling a continuous assembly of Skyrmions and antiSkyrmions, with fields set to the vacuum outside their respective cores.
- Beyond initial conditions derived from the straightforward ansatz (3.7), more advanced initial conditions based on the rational map ansatz [11] with an axially symmetric charge $n$ map were also employed.
